software_class: browser extension or web augmentation layer with permission constraints

options.name: Content script extension
options.when_not_to_use: Avoid when background automation is the main behavior.
options.rationale: Keeps augmentation close to the page context.
options.risks: Host permission scope can become too broad.

options.name: Background service extension
options.when_to_use: Events, storage, or cross-page coordination are central.
options.when_not_to_use: Avoid when page-only augmentation is enough.

options.name: Side panel extension
options.when_to_use: Users need a persistent assistant or tool surface.
options.when_not_to_use: Avoid when inline page action is better.
options.rationale: Separates tool UI from page content.
options.tradeoffs: Panel context can drift from page state.
options.risks: UX may feel detached without clear sync.
